title: Mang Den plateau day
summary: Pa Sy in the morning, Dak Ke lake after lunch, and Kon Pring before the lodge quiet.

days.title: Water, lake, and communal house
days.body: Start at Pa Sy while the forest is cool. The provincial fee is 50,000 VND for adults from 30 May 2026. Drive to Dak Ke lake for a shore walk, then finish at Kon Pring for gong culture on Highway 24. Church and pagoda stops fit only if you still have daylight.

seoTitle: One day on the Mang Den plateau
seoDescription: Pa Sy waterfall, Dak Ke lake, and Kon Pring village from a Mang Den base.
